### Observed differences

In the later window, activity A24 appears in about 53 in 100 traces, up from about 40 in 100 traces before; its mean occurrences per trace rose from 0.40 to 0.53. There was no change in recurrence (activity repeated within a trace) in either window. [OCC001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. The single observed difference is within the range that an unchanged process can produce given the screening expectation of about 0.5 qualifying items, and it reflects only a participation increase without any relational or positional evidence. [OCC001]
